backendReliabilityChecklist.BOUND: No new collection. Exact input is one scalar in the existing single-case demonstration; existing request chunks/runtime collections are not production-bounded and remain outside this local-demo repair.
backendReliabilityChecklist.HONEST_STATUS: Existing 400/404 failure mapping retained; premature export/proposal refused. Real transport failure and retry captured.
backendReliabilityChecklist.HONEST_SCORES: No score or authority gate changed. Identity-unbound browser certification correctly exits1, certified:false.
backendReliabilityChecklist.TIMEOUT: No new external request. Each proof command bounded; inherited demonstration API timeout behavior unchanged.
backendReliabilityChecklist.SSRF: No user-controlled outbound URL or new network integration.
backendReliabilityChecklist.BOUND_READ: No external response reader added; inherited local-server request-body limits not claimed repaired.
backendReliabilityChecklist.ERROR_BOUNDARY: Existing client/server error owners retained; visible failure/recovery verified.
backendReliabilityChecklist.DETERMINISTIC: Existing sorted-key Caseflow hashing retained and independently recalculated over exported JSON.
